parameters.note: The seventh day stays rest (ADR-027 #15). The program contract allows the same: ProgramRequest.trainingDays maxItems.

The onboarding asks how many days (2 to 5) and places them itself (ADR-072 #4); the user moves them any time. Two days only as the user's choice: the engine never proposes fewer than three (ADR-071 #8).

ADR-072 #3, #5: an experienced user is asked the load they lift about this many times. The server reads it too: the load is a first target only on a day whose rep range starts at this or under; a day starting higher finds its load in the first session.

ADR-072 #3, #5: the three main moves an experienced user is asked a working weight for (prototype #ob-weights: squat, bench press, deadlift; the catalog's deadlift is the Romanian deadlift). Each is in every program template (data/programs), so a weight given has its move in the program the onboarding builds; parameters.test.ts holds it.

#ob-weights' stepper: the first tap sets an empty bar (20 kg, 45 lb), then each step is a pair of the smallest common plates (prototype: 2.5 kg; as workout.json warmup_round_kg and warmup_round_lb). A move left unset is skipped: its weight is found in the first session (ADR-072 #5).
How long each example call shows on the welcome screen (prototype #welcome). They turn once and rest on the first: no endless motion; with Reduce Motion on, the first stays.

Where the about-you wheels start (prototype #ob-about: 178 cm, 84 kg, born 1999 in 2026). Height and year start as the answer, so Continue is open; the weight goes out as the first weigh-in, so it counts only once the person moves its wheel.
The weight wheel's first row and its steps (prototype: half kilograms); its last row is weigh_in_max_kg, what the server keeps.
Adults only, certainly 18 on every day of the year with only the birth year kept (ADR-027 #13, K-225).
Profile.heightCm minimum; in imperial the shortest accepted is 3 ft 4 in (K-310).
Self-monitoring drops Thursday to Sunday; Monday closes the week and plans the next at once. The first call comes on the first Monday (ADR-018).
The same as measurement.yaml › photo_interval_weeks (the engine's); parameters.test.ts keeps them equal.
The same as windows.yaml › no_interpretation_days (U8); parameters.test.ts keeps them equal.
NewWeighIn.kg maximum: a heavier starting weight would be refused by the server and lost from the queue.

K-521 (ADR-040 #3, ADR-041 #66): 'the app not opened' — one of the week-5 risk signals (I1 F2), known only on the phone. No source gives a number; a week, as the other signals read the user's week just over: the app not opened in the days before today's open.
